name: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive
description: The Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive is a premier open-access repository of diverse real-world time series datasets designed for comprehensive forecasting model benchmarking. Created by Monash University, it provides standardized, clean time series collections across economics, energy, transport, healthcare, and nature with consistent evaluation metrics and baseline forecasting benchmarks.
